facts.fact: Dimension Data Limited, a Lagos fibre and connectivity provider, raised N4.05 billion (about US$2.9 million) from high-net-worth investors, unnamed, in the first tranche of a N20 billion bond programme, closed at a signing ceremony on 27 July 2026 with Pathway Advisors as lead issuing house.

Dimension Data Limited funded its Nigerian fibre expansion through the domestic capital market, the document says, with N4.05 billion raised from high-net-worth investors in a naira bond in July 2026.

note: Deal recorded; no information system named.
